title: laparoscopic versus robotic bariatric surgery - Comparison of Outcomes and Economics
summary: The aim of this trial is to compare the clinical outcomes and economic impacts of laparoscopic versus robot-assisted bariatric surgery. Additionally, the study investigates whether the presence of a da Vinci system has a structural effect—beyond its clinical impact—thereby influencing patient volume.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Adult patients undergoing elective bariatric surgery
Exclusion criteria:
- Lack of legal capacity
- Minority (being a minor)
- Lack of patient consent
- Pregnancy
